verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a dedicated fiat-to-crypto onramp with multiple embedding modes (hosted redirect, embedded website widget, embedded mobile SDK), lets users buy stablecoins via cards/bank transfers, and Stripe handles KYC/compliance/fraud liability as merchant of record. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of the onramp widget integration experience (community evidence covers payments/payouts, not the onramp widget specifically).
